agents.name: Health agent
agents.scope: Health Hub for each pet: Overview, Schedule, History and Insights, the Vet section, Emergency card and emergency call or message, quick log, documents and PDF sharing.

milestones.title: Setup: read AGENTS.md, pub get, baseline analyze and tests green
Data layer: models, species settings, HealthRepository, seeded in-memory fake, injectable clock
Health tab shell, Overview and getting started; Vet section, health profile, Emergency card, emergency actions (Call, Message, Map) and the pieces for Home
History: timeline with filters and search, record detail, record form with next due date, photo and PDF attachments
Schedule: Today / Upcoming / Needs review, routines, medicines with reminders, recording a dose
Insights and Quick log: weight trend, species-aware observation journal; PDF summary to share
Supabase repository and migration 0002_health.sql: tables, documents bucket, row level security
Widget tests for every flow, right-to-left check, analyzer clean, final report
